hook_verbatim: Everyone wonders how French women are always so well dressed, sexy, but also understated with that little je ne sais quoi. And the truth is, there are a lot of rules in French fashion that French women are taught from a very young age by their mothers and grandmothers. And I haven't seen any of those rules on the internet. So in this video, I'm going to share with you exactly what I was taught by my mother and my grandmother growing up as a French girl.
promise: The speaker promises to share the exact French fashion rules taught to her by her mother and grandmother while growing up in France.

points.name: Heels always make an outfit more feminine
points.exact_words: Rule number one that I've touched upon: Heels will always make an outfit more feminine. Up to 7 cm, your heels are in the traditional category, so they're what we consider elegant. Above 7 cm, they move to the sexy category.
points.why_given: Heels elevate an outfit's femininity, with heel height and width determining whether the vibe is elegant or sexy.
points.how_shown: Speaker talking to camera, graphic showing heel height scale (5cm to 10cm) with 'Traditional/Elegant' vs 'Sexy' sections, side-by-side photos of models in heels.
points.example_pieces: 5-7cm heels, 8-10cm heels, block heels, thin stiletto heels, black pumps, slingbacks

points.name: A tucked top looks more feminine
points.exact_words: Rule number two: Tucking in your shirt or t-shirt or pullover will elongate your leg and emphasize your waist.
points.why_given: Tucking in your top defines your waistline and creates longer-looking legs, resulting in a more feminine silhouette.
points.how_shown: Side-by-side comparison of speaker standing in white pants and grey t-shirt: untucked on the right vs tucked-in on the left with red proportion line graphic.

points.name: Balance out the volume of your outfit
points.exact_words: Rule number three: Never do all skinny or all baggy. If you're wearing something close to the body at the bottom, wear something that's wider at the top.
points.why_given: Balancing volume between top and bottom prevents an outfit from looking overly tight or shapeless, maintaining elegance.
points.how_shown: Side-by-side comparison of speaker trying on outfits: tight tank top with skinny jeans vs loose ruffled blouse with skinny jeans, and oversized shirt vs tucked t-shirt.
points.example_pieces: Tight tank top, black skinny jeans, ruffled white blouse, oversized white shirt, grey t-shirt

points.name: Natural materials look expensive, artificial ones look cheap
points.exact_words: Rule number four: Natural materials look expensive, whereas artificial materials look cheap, even if you spend the same amount of money on them.
points.why_given: Natural fabrics elevate the perceived quality of an outfit, while synthetic materials tend to look inexpensive.
points.how_shown: Side-by-side outfit comparison showing polyester shirt (marked with red X) vs cotton shirt (marked with green check), both priced at $30.
points.example_pieces: Polyester white shirt, cotton white shirt, black jeans

points.name: Underwear should not be visible
points.exact_words: Rule number five: Your underwear should not be visible. It should not be visible in color and it should not be visible in shape.
points.why_given: Visible panty lines, bulging bra straps, or showing underwear colors create an unpolished, unflattering look.
points.how_shown: Speaker talking to camera, photos of bad examples (visible underwear lines through sheer pants), skin-tone underwear diagram, bra sizing diagrams and fit comparison photos.
points.example_pieces: Nude underwear, red bra under white shirt, seamless panties, proper fitting bra

points.name: Match the color of your leather accessories
points.exact_words: Rule number six is to match your leather accessories. It's not a hard rule, but it's an easy cheat code to always look good.
points.why_given: Matching leather items creates a cohesive, effortlessly coordinated aesthetic.
points.how_shown: Three outfit try-on comparisons: white bag with beige/black shoes (green check mark), black bag with black sandals (green check mark), black bag with brown belt (red X mark).
points.example_pieces: White leather handbag, black leather shoulder bag, brown belt, black sandals, beige cap-toe block heels

points.name: Wide clothes make you look bigger
points.exact_words: Rule number seven: Wide clothes make you look bigger, regardless of the actual size of your body. When hiding all those shapes under one straight piece of clothing, you're actually erasing the relief of your body.
points.why_given: Oversized, shapeless clothing hides natural body contours and adds visual bulk, whereas fitted clothing flatters all shapes.
points.how_shown: Photo comparisons of women wearing shapeless oversized tops (marked NO/red X) vs fitted/tucked outfits highlighting waist (marked YES/green check).
points.example_pieces: Shapeless tunic, wide leg trousers, tucked button-down shirt, fitted tee

points.name: Choose between showing legs or cleavage
points.exact_words: Rule number eight: If you're showing cleavage, don't show legs. If you're showing legs, don't show cleavage.
points.why_given: Balancing skin exposure maintains sophisticated elegance without looking overly provocative.
points.how_shown: Side-by-side photos: shorts with jacket/covered top (green check) vs mini skirt with low-cut top (red X).
points.example_pieces: White shorts with blazer, mini skirt with halter top

points.name: Iron your clothes and keep your leathers clean
points.exact_words: Rule number nine: Ironed clothes and clean accessories make the world of a difference in how put-together you're going to look.
points.why_given: Wrinkle-free clothes and clean leather instantly upgrade how neat and stylish an outfit appears.
points.how_shown: Split-screen video comparison of speaker in an unironed white shirt vs a crisp ironed white shirt with hand gesture.

points.name: Limit the amount of sexy elements in your outfit to two MAX
points.exact_words: Rule number ten: Unless you want to dress in a very sexy way, is to limit the number of elements in your outfit with a sexy connotation to one, two max. Otherwise, your outfit can very quickly, from a French perspective, fall into the tacky/trashy sexy category.
points.why_given: Over-combining seductive elements crosses the line into tacky, whereas limiting them keeps the look chic.
points.how_shown: Photo overlays showing outfits categorized by number of sexy elements (e.g. high heels + corset = 2 max vs 4 elements = tacky).
points.example_pieces: High heels, corset, tight ripped jeans, leather pants, off-shoulder sweater

mid_video_asks.action: Invites viewers to subscribe to the channel and post questions in the comments.

ending_verbatim: Thank you for spending this time with me. I will see you very happily in the next one, and until then, à bientôt.
